## Verdict

**Inkwell** costs least for a team of 22, at **$242 per month**. Its $11 per-seat rate is the lowest on the list, and its 20-seat minimum sits just below the team size, so all 22 seats are billed at list with no padding. Dorado is next at $528, and Borealis is most expensive at $600 — its 40-seat minimum forces payment for 18 seats the team will not use.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Dorado | $24 | 5 |
| Inkwell | $11 | 20 |
| Borealis | $15 | 40 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 22 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Inkwell:** minimum 20 < 22, so 22 seats paid. 22 × $11 = **$242 per month**. Effective rate $11.00 per person.
- **Dorado:** minimum 5 < 22, so 22 seats paid. 22 × $24 = **$528 per month**. Effective rate $24.00 per person.
- **Borealis:** minimum 40 > 22, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $15 = **$600 per month**. Effective rate $27.27 per person ($600 ÷ 22); 18 seats worth $270 go unused.

Inkwell is $286 per month cheaper than Dorado and $358 per month cheaper than Borealis. Over twelve months that is $3,432 and $4,296 respectively.

## Risks

- **Inkwell's margin depends on staying at or above 20 people.** A drop below 20 still bills the 20-seat floor ($220), raising the effective per-person rate. Dorado's 5-seat minimum makes it the more forgiving option for a shrinking team, though at $24 per seat it only undercuts Inkwell's $220 floor below 9 people.
- **Borealis is penalised purely by its minimum at this size.** At 40 seats its rate is $15 against Inkwell's $11, so it does not overtake Inkwell on list price at any headcount — the gap narrows but never closes.
- **Price only.** The list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, integrations, or security posture. A cheaper seat may buy less product, and nothing here measures that.
- **Monthly list pricing as stated.** Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees, and overage charges are not in the source and could reorder these totals.
